'''2010 Yavin 4 Regionals''' was a Players Committee regional, 2010, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Legacy Open]]). The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDF ([[:File:2010 Yavin 4 Regionals.pdf]]).

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Site:''' —
* '''Dates:''' 2010
* '''Winner:''' —
